name: aside
description: A prompt queue for Claude Code. Queue prompts, ideas and comments while Claude works, without interrupting it, and send them once it finishes or whenever you are ready.

afterClaudeAnswers.title: After Claude answers
afterClaudeAnswers.description: What aside does by itself when Claude finishes answering and something is queued. wait: nothing, you run /aside. plan: what /aside plan does. run all: what /aside run all does.

order.title: Which entry comes first
order.description: oldest: first in, first out. newest: last in, first out. /aside lists, numbers and runs the queue in this order.

tidy.title: Tidy what you type
tidy.description: on: a small model fixes the spelling, punctuation and wording of each entry's own text, in its language, once it is queued. The copied quote is never changed or sent. off: entries stay as typed.
